title: 1 + 2 + … + n as triangle numbers
caption: The sums 1, 1 + 2, 1 + 2 + 3, … are the triangle numbers 1, 3, 6, 10, 15. Each step adds a row of k + 1 dots, which is the inductive step k(k + 1)/2 + (k + 1) = (k + 1)(k + 2)/2.
alt: Five triangles of dots with 1, 3, 6, 10 and 15 dots, each one row longer than the last.
description: For n = 1 the sum is 1 = 1 × 2/2: the base case.
Each new triangle adds a row with one more dot than the last.
Adding row k + 1 turns k(k + 1)/2 into (k + 1)(k + 2)/2.
So n(n + 1)/2 holds for every n ≥ 1; for example n = 5 gives 15.
